//: Type-checks the panels' own tests. They run under `bun test`, which does not
type-check, so without this a changed signature reached the tests unnoticed
and they went on passing against a shape that could no longer occur.
This is the one config in devtools-ui/ still read by the ROOT TypeScript
(^7.0.2) rather than by the nested Angular toolchain (>=6.0 <6.1), which is
why `include` names only `tests/` and lets imports pull the rest in (#483).
It used to list `src/**/*.ts`, and that would now drag Angular components
and @angular/* type positions into a compiler that cannot resolve them.
Entry-driven is also the more honest scope: everything these tests cover is
framework-free by design — format, history, flamegraph, profileTree,
stateDiff, actorsTree, uptime — so what tsc walks into from here is exactly
the substance the tests assert on, and nothing that merely happens to sit
